name: tahu-edge
title: Tahu Edge Node / Device
description: Sparkplug B Edge Node and Device support over MQTT using Eclipse Tahu
label: messaging,iot,monitoring

properties.name: deviceId
properties.label: producer (device only)
properties.description: ID of this edge node device

properties.name: checkClientIdLength
properties.label: common
properties.description: MQTT client ID length check enabled

properties.name: clientId
properties.label: common
properties.description: MQTT client ID to use for all server definitions, rather than specifying the same one for each. Note that if neither the 'clientId' parameter nor an 'MqttClientId' are defined for an MQTT Server, a random MQTT Client ID will be generated automatically, prefaced with 'Camel'

properties.name: keepAliveTimeout
properties.label: common
properties.description: MQTT connection keep alive timeout, in seconds

properties.name: rebirthDebounceDelay
properties.label: common
properties.description: Delay before recurring node rebirth messages will be sent

properties.name: servers
properties.label: common
properties.description: MQTT server definitions, given with the following syntax in a comma-separated list: MqttServerName:(MqttClientId:)(tcp/ssl)://hostname(:port),...

properties.name: metricDataTypePayloadMap
properties.label: producer
properties.description: Tahu SparkplugBPayloadMap to configure metric data types for this edge node or device. Note that this payload is used exclusively as a Sparkplug B spec-compliant configuration for all possible edge node or device metric names, aliases, and data types. This configuration is required to publish proper Sparkplug B NBIRTH and DBIRTH payloads.

properties.name: headerFilterStrategy
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: To use a custom HeaderFilterStrategy to filter headers used as Sparkplug metrics. Default value notice: Defaults to sending all Camel Message headers with name prefixes of CamelTahuMetric., including those with null values

properties.name: lazyStartProducer
properties.label: producer,advanced
properties.description: Whether the producer should be started lazy (on the first message). By starting lazy you can use this to allow CamelContext and routes to startup in situations where a producer may otherwise fail during starting and cause the route to fail being started. By deferring this startup to be lazy then the startup failure can be handled during routing messages via Camel's routing error handlers. Beware that when the first message is processed then creating and starting the producer may take a little time and prolong the total processing time of the processing.

properties.name: bdSeqManager
properties.label: producer (edge node only),advanced
properties.description: To use a specific org.eclipse.tahu.message.BdSeqManager implementation to manage edge node birth-death sequence numbers

properties.name: bdSeqNumPath
properties.label: producer (edge node only),advanced
properties.description: Path for Sparkplug B NBIRTH/NDEATH sequence number persistence files. This path will contain files named as -bdSeqNum and must be writable by the executing process' user

properties.name: useAliases
properties.label: producer (edge node only),advanced
properties.description: Flag enabling support for metric aliases

properties.name: deviceIds
properties.label: producer (edge node only)
properties.description: ID of each device connected to this edge node, as a comma-separated list

properties.name: primaryHostId
properties.label: producer (edge node only)
properties.description: Host ID of the primary host application for this edge node

properties.name: sslContextParameters
properties.label: security
properties.description: SSL configuration for MQTT server connections
